sloka: प्रसादः क्रियताम् देवि भद्रे राज्ञो विशेषतः ।शून्येन खलु सुश्रोणि मया इदम् समुदाह्Rतम् ॥२-१३-२१॥
transliteration: prasādaḥ kriyatām devi bhadre rājño viśeṣataḥ ।śūnyena khalu suśroṇi mayā idam samudāhRtam ॥2-13-21॥

translations.english: O lady with fair hips, I hope whatever I have said has not been a cry in the (empty) sky. O young lady show me this favour. Surely you are kindhearted.
